encoding_charset.key_comment: [Optional] Define file encoding; If in doubt, leave it blank or use UTF8.

source_dir.key_comment: Define the absolute path to your source file directory (base directory for all objects). This directory contains files to be extracted. Used when file connector (CSV/Parquet/JSON) is configured as source. Complementary to object_source_dir: If source_dir is set and object_source_dir is set, final path = source_dir + / + object_source_dir. If object_source_dir is not set but source_dir is, final path = source_dir + / + object_name. If source_dir is empty, object_source_dir must be an absolute path.

destination_dir.key_comment: Define the absolute path to your destination file directory. This directory will serve as the final destination for your extracted files. Used when file connector (CSV/Parquet/JSON) is configured as target.

newlines_in_values.key_comment: Whether newline characters are allowed in file values. Setting this to True reduces the performance of multi-threaded file reading.

ignore_empty_lines.key_comment: Whether empty lines are ignored in file input. If False, an empty line is interpreted as containing a single empty value (assuming a one-column file).
